Subject: MSA & Order Form intake — signatory evidence, template handover

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the time on the demo last week. We want to get contracting moving so we can align on scope and timeline. To keep intake tidy, could you please share the following by end of day Tuesday: 

- A single PDF of your current MSA (we'll treat anything you send as the starting point).
- The Order Form you want us to use (xlsx if you have fields we should map).
- A signatory matrix (name, title, email, authority level) and confirmation of whether a PO or DocuSign is preferred.
- Any procurement-specific requirements (insurance limits, additional payee info, tax forms).

Internal ask: Kimberly, can you confirm our standard Exhibit list and whether we should pre-populate Redwood's template clauses for residency? Marissa, please check billing contact and invoice cadence — we'll need that for the order form mapping.

Target: get a first-pass redline from legal within 7 business days after we receive their MSA + party sheet. If there are residency or export-control constraints we should treat them as blockers; flag here early.

Thanks —

Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Dylan —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching our current MSA and the Order Form workbook. The signatory matrix is attached as a CSV. A couple of quick notes: 

- We typically require signature by CFO for enterprise deals > $250k; our signatory matrix flags that.
- Procurement prefers DocuSign, but they can accept a PO for payment if Redwood needs that for invoicing.
- Insurance: we meet 1M/3M limits, certificate available on request.

I'll put procurement@procurement.stratagem.ai on the thread for formal SOW/PO discussions — they handle the invoicing side.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships | Stratagem AI
elena@stratagem.ai

Subject: RE: MSA & Order Form intake — signatory evidence, template handover

Dylan / Marissa —

Got the attachments from Elena, reviewed at a high level. Initial legal/ops notes and proposed owners: 

1) Template fit: Stratagem's MSA is broadly standard but sections on data residency (Sec 4) and termination for convenience differ from our template. Legal will run a clause-by-clause. Owner: Legal (I will triage). Deliverable: redline + comment matrix.

2) Signatory matrix: CFO signature requirement for threshold noted. Ops ask: confirm anticipated ARR/total contract value so we can set escalation path (Samir in Sales Eng will also need to know for SOW sizing). Owner: Sales (Dylan) to confirm.

3) Order Form mapping: there are custom billing fields in the XLSX (tax id, remit address). Marissa, can you map those to our purchase order fields and confirm billing contact details (name/email and whether they require invoice PDF + CSV file)? Owner: Marissa.

4) Security evidence: Elena mentioned insurance certificate; also request SOC 2 report if available. If they are hosting in EU regions, we'll need residency language. Owner: Security (I'll loop them if SOC2 not attached).

Timeline: I can turn around a prioritized redline within 5 business days after we confirm the billing/billing contact + total contract value. If residency or export control issues appear, that will push to ~10 business days.

Questions for external: Elena — can you confirm the expected ARR or committed term so we can route approvals appropriately? Also, who at procurement will sign the DocuSign envelope?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@stratagem.ai>, procurement@stratagem.ai
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form intake — signatory evidence, template handover

Elena / procurement team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and attachments. To answer Kimberly's ask: anticipated first-year committed spend is ~$180k (annual contract, one-year term) — below the CFO threshold, so primary signatory will be VP of Finance (name in the attached CSV). 

Marissa — please map the billing fields and confirm whether they need invoice PDFs or prefer CSV ingest (we support both; SCB prefers CSV+PDF).

Plan of record: 
- Kimberly will produce a prioritized redline + comment matrix by 2027-07-26 (5 business days).
- If Stratagem needs any clause changes for data residency, we'll surface them in that redline and call out any approval blockers.
- Once parties agree on core commercial terms, we prefer DocuSign for signature. We can also accept PO for invoice processing.

Elena — could you confirm the procurement contact who will receive the DocuSign envelope (name + email) and whether an internal legal reviewer will join the redline exchange? If procurement prefers, we can route a draft via DocuSign with editable fields for signatory later.

I'll follow up with a short mutual action plan after Kimberly's redline is in.

Thanks —

Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
